model_progress.reading: aligned_dense - center_only and aligned_dense - frozen Ordered + B3 are both consistent positive in multi segment F1@50 in both halves, and aligned_dense meets every constraint and the goal -> 'it improves on the current strong system'; meeting the old numbers alone is not enough

mechanism_support.reading: on all mixed windows (session bootstrap), aligned_dense - center_only and aligned_dense - shuffled_dense are consistent positive in both halves; aligned_dense - center_only is consistent positive in multi segment F1@50 in both halves; and aligned_dense has a feasible B3 setting, native macro-F1 at the floor and boundary recall >= 0.95 in every seed and half -> 'this recipe supports time-aligned supervision'; it does not need the old mean goal and does not mean beating the frozen strong reference; a half with a stream-sensitivity conflict makes the reading uncertain

system_only.reading: aligned_dense - center_only consistent positive in multi segment F1@50 in both halves without mechanism support -> the system result is kept and the mechanism is undetermined

shuffled_only.reading: aligned_dense beats shuffled_dense consistently (all-mixed accuracy or multi segment F1@50) in a half, while aligned_dense - center_only is consistent positive on neither in either half -> no practical gain

tradeoff.reading: aligned_dense - center_only is consistent positive on all-mixed accuracy or multi segment F1@50 in a half, but aligned_dense fails a constraint or lacks the two-half system gain -> the trade-off is reported and this configuration ends

no_gain.reading: aligned_dense - center_only is consistent positive on neither all-mixed accuracy nor multi segment F1@50 in either half, and aligned_dense - frozen Ordered + B3 is not consistent positive in either half -> this configuration ends; dense supervision in general is not rejected

end.reading: the round ends at its report; no teacher, boundary loss, gate, new head, lambda sweep, more epochs or seeds, and no sampling change from development cases
